name: Vintage Belt-Drive Record Player with Wockoder Bookshelf Speakers (Bluetooth, 3-Speed)
description: Retro-style black wooden belt-drive turntable for vinyl records, paired with external Wockoder dual stereo bookshelf speakers. Plays records at 3 speeds, supports wireless AUX/Bluetooth input, and has a headphone jack with auto-stop function. A complete vinyl listening setup ready to use.
